expected_structural_delta: One new module (phase-timing.sh), four thin wrappers whose bodies move unchanged into *_steps functions, marks inside existing functions. No new daemon, setting, dependency or lock.
minimum_design: A small phase-timing module with a begin/mark/end accumulator using Bash dynamic scope; thin wrappers around cmd_recycle, github_start_one, autoscale_tick and lifecycle_tick that keep output and status; lock wait/hold in with_fleet_lock; batch timing in the exit-event dispatch; one capped file in RUNDIR.
outcome: Each fleet operation records where its time goes (lock wait and hold, recycle and start steps, tick sections, exit batches) in a bounded runtime file, with no change to what any operation does or returns.

reuse_decisions.name: log()/daemon logs
reuse_decisions.rationale: Daemon logs are untimestamped and never trimmed; timing needs its own bounded file.

reuse_decisions.name: with_fleet_lock
reuse_decisions.rationale: Measure wait and hold at the one acquire helper, keeping its exit statuses.
